positive_cases.name: binary_in_tmp
positive_cases.scenario: Binary executed from the temporary directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Writable directory selection matches and the workspace filter does not apply.

positive_cases.name: binary_in_shared_memory
positive_cases.scenario: Binary executed from the shared memory directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Writable directory selection matches and the workspace filter does not apply.

negative_cases.name: binary_in_usr_bin
negative_cases.scenario: System utility executed from the managed binary directory.
negative_cases.rationale: The writable directory selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: approved_build_output
negative_cases.scenario: Freshly built binary executed from the approved workspace.
negative_cases.rationale: Path matches the selection but the workspace filter removes the event.

negative_cases.name: binary_in_opt
negative_cases.scenario: Application executed from the optional software directory.
negative_cases.rationale: The writable directory selection does not match.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
